pages.title: AI 全貌与基础原理 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 面向 AI 初学者和非技术读者的免费知识项目，通过知识地图、概念解释和学习进度记录，认识 AI 世界的全貌与基础逻辑。

pages.title: 搜索与文字目录 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 按概念名称、别名和已发布理解页正文搜索 AI 知识地图，并以文字形式浏览概念关系。

pages.title: 关于 AI 知识地图 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: AI 知识地图 / AI Knowledge Map 是由 LittleFishK 维护的免费 AI 入门知识项目。了解项目目的、维护方式、使用许可和纠错入口。

pages.title: 聚类：相似度、簇形状与用途共同决定分组 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 K-means 的分配—更新手算，到层次、DBSCAN、混合模型、选 k、稳定性和业务解释。

pages.title: Clustering: Similarity, Cluster Shape, and Use Case Jointly Determine Grouping · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From manual K-means assignment–update computation to hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, mixture models, choosing k, stability, and business interpretation.

pages.title: 宪法式 AI：用显式原则指导批评、修订与偏好学习 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从原则文本、情境解释、冲突优先级到 AI 反馈训练，理解怎样减少逐例人工标签，以及为什么原则选择仍然是治理问题。

pages.title: Constitutional AI: Using Explicit Principles to Guide Critique, Revision, and Preference Learning · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From principle text, contextual interpretation, and conflict priority to AI feedback training, understand how to reduce per-example human labels and why principle selection remains a governance issue.

pages.title: 维度灾难：空间变大后，数据为何迅速变稀 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从体积指数增长、距离集中和样本复杂度理解高维检索、密度估计与降维的必要性。

pages.title: The Curse of Dimensionality: Why Data Rapidly Becomes Sparse as Space Grows · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Understanding the necessity of high-dimensional retrieval, density estimation, and dimensionality reduction through exponential volume growth, distance concentration, and sample complexity.

pages.title: 决策树与集成方法：用分裂规则组合非线性决策 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从不纯度、信息增益、剪枝到随机森林和梯度提升，理解树模型对表格数据的优势与泄漏风险。

pages.title: Decision Trees and Ensemble Methods: Combining Nonlinear Decisions with Split Rules · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From impurity, information gain, and pruning to random forests and gradient boosting, understand the advantages of tree models for tabular data and the risk of leakage.

pages.title: 降维：用更少坐标保留任务所需结构 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 PCA、随机投影、t-SNE、UMAP 与自编码器理解压缩目标、可视化失真、数据泄漏和下游评测。

pages.title: Dimensionality Reduction: Preserving Task-Required Structure with Fewer Coordinates · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Understand compression objectives, visualization distortion, data leakage, and downstream evaluation through PCA, random projection, t-SNE, UMAP, and autoencoders.

pages.title: 循环神经网络 RNN：把历史压进一个不断更新的状态 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从共享递推、时间展开与 BPTT，到梯度连乘、LSTM 门控、教师强制和流式部署。

pages.title: Recurrent Neural Network (RNN): Compressing History into a Continuously Updated State · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From shared recurrence, time unrolling, and BPTT, to gradient multiplication, LSTM gating, teacher forcing, and streaming deployment.

pages.title: 卷积神经网络 CNN：让同一个局部检测器扫遍空间 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从离散卷积、权重共享和输出形状，到感受野、采样混叠、平移等变与现代视觉骨干。

pages.title: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN): Letting the Same Local Detector Scan Across Space · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From discrete convolution, weight sharing, and output shapes, to receptive fields, sampling aliasing, translation equivariance, and modern visual backbones.

pages.title: 嵌入 Embedding · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 把文字变成向量，让「意思相近」变成「距离相近」

pages.title: Embedding · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Turn text into vectors, making “similar meaning” become “close in distance”

pages.title: 注意力机制 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 处理每个词时，让模型自己决定该「看」句子里的哪些词

pages.title: Attention Mechanism · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: When processing each word, let the model decide for itself which words in the sentence to 'look at'.

pages.title: 反向传播：把一个结果的责任高效分回全部参数 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从计算图、局部导数和上游梯度开始，完整手算一次反向遍历，并理解分叉累加、向量—雅可比积、激活缓存和梯度检查。

pages.title: Backpropagation: Efficiently Assigning the Responsibility of One Result Back to All Parameters · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Starting from computational graphs, local derivatives, and upstream gradients, work through one complete backward traversal by hand, and understand branch accumulation, vector–Jacobian products, activation caching, and gradient checking.

pages.title: Token 与分词：模型真正读写的离散语言 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 Unicode、预切分、BPE/Unigram、字节回退到特殊 token，理解同一句文本为何会变成不同长度、不同成本和不同能力边界。

pages.title: Tokens and Tokenization: The Discrete Language That Models Actually Read and Write · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From Unicode, pre-tokenization, BPE/Unigram, byte fallback, and special tokens, understand why the same text yields different lengths, different costs, and different capability boundaries.

pages.title: 批归一化：用批统计稳定通道尺度 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从卷积张量的统计轴、训练/推理双路径、运行均值到同步 BatchNorm，理解它为何加速许多视觉网络，又为何会在小批量、域迁移和部署融合时失效。

pages.title: Batch Normalization: Stabilizing Channel Scale with Batch Statistics · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From the statistical axes of convolutional tensors, training/inference dual paths, and running means to synchronized BatchNorm, understand why it accelerates many visual networks and why it fails with small batches, domain shift, and deployment fusion.

pages.title: 微调 Fine-tuning · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 在预训练的「通才」上继续训练，调成某个任务的「专才」

pages.title: Fine-tuning · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Continue training on a pre-trained “generalist” to turn it into a task-specific “specialist”

pages.title: 知识蒸馏：让小学生逼近教师的条件分布与行为 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从软标签、温度与 KL，到 token/序列/特征蒸馏、覆盖缺口、容量上限和偏差继承。

pages.title: Knowledge Distillation: Making a Small Student Approach the Teacher's Conditional Distribution and Behavior · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From soft labels, temperature, and KL, to token/sequence/feature distillation, coverage gaps, capacity limits, and bias inheritance.

pages.title: 上下文窗口 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 模型一次能「看见」的 token 总量上限

pages.title: Context Window · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: The maximum total number of tokens a model can “see” at once

pages.title: PEFT / LoRA：冻结主干，只学习低秩权重增量 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 ΔW=BA、rank 与缩放，到可训练参数账、QLoRA、目标模块、合并版本和多适配器干扰。

pages.title: PEFT / LoRA: Freezing the backbone, learning only low-rank weight increments · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From ΔW=BA, rank, and scaling, to trainable parameter accounting, QLoRA, target modules, merged versions, and multi-adapter interference.

pages.title: 预训练 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 在海量无标注文本上自监督学习，一次性把「通用能力」灌进模型

pages.title: Pre-training · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Self-supervised learning on massive unlabeled text, instilling “general capabilities” into the model in one go

pages.title: 量化：把连续参数压到有限格点 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 scale、zero-point 和舍入误差，到粒度、异常值、PTQ/QAT、权重/激活/KV 与硬件内核。

pages.title: Quantization: Compressing Continuous Parameters onto a Finite Lattice · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From scale, zero-point, and rounding error, to granularity, outliers, PTQ/QAT, weights/activations/KV, and hardware kernels.

pages.title: 后训练 Post-training · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 预训练给能力，后训练决定这些能力怎样被调用和呈现

pages.title: Post-training · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Pre-training provides capabilities; post-training determines how those capabilities are invoked and presented.

pages.title: 归一化：控制表示尺度，稳定深层优化 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 LayerNorm 的中心化、RMSNorm 的均方根缩放，到 Pre-Norm/Post-Norm 与实现验收，理解归一化究竟沿哪条轴统计、保留什么、又丢掉什么。

pages.title: Normalization: Controlling Representation Scale, Stabilizing Deep Optimization · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From LayerNorm's centering and RMSNorm's root-mean-square scaling, to Pre-Norm/Post-Norm and implementation acceptance, understand exactly which axis normalization computes statistics along, what it retains, and what it discards.

pages.title: 优化器与学习率调度：把瞬时梯度变成可控训练轨迹 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 SGD、Momentum、Adam 与 AdamW 的状态更新，到预热、平台、衰减、批量规模和混合精度；理解一套训练配方为什么必须整体调试。

pages.title: Optimizers and Learning Rate Schedules: Turning Instantaneous Gradients into a Controllable Training Trajectory · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From the state updates of SGD, Momentum, Adam, and AdamW, to warm-up, plateau, decay, batch size, and mixed precision; understand why a training recipe must be tuned as a whole.

pages.title: 损失函数：把‘哪里错了’变成可学习的方向 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从业务代价到可微代理，从单样本误差到经验风险；用同一个数值例子看见损失、梯度和参数更新怎样接成闭环。

pages.title: Loss Function: Turning ‘Where It Went Wrong’ into a Learnable Direction · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From business cost to a differentiable proxy, from single-sample error to empirical risk; using the same numerical example, see how the loss, gradient, and parameter update connect into a closed loop.

pages.title: 自监督学习：让数据自己产生训练目标 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 统一理解自回归、遮盖重建、对比学习与自蒸馏，并追踪预文本目标怎样迁移、走捷径或错位。

pages.title: Self-supervised Learning: Letting Data Generate Its Own Training Targets · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: A unified understanding of autoregression, masked reconstruction, contrastive learning, and self-distillation, and tracing how pretext objectives transfer, take shortcuts, or become misaligned.

pages.title: 位置编码与 RoPE：让注意力知道顺序和距离 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从排列等变、正弦绝对位置、相对偏置到旋转位置编码，理解顺序怎样进入注意力，以及长上下文扩展为何不是改一个窗口数字。

pages.title: Positional Encoding and RoPE: Making Attention Know Order and Distance · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From permutation equivariance, sinusoidal absolute positions, and relative bias to rotary position embeddings, understand how order enters attention and why long-context extension is not simply changing a window number.

pages.title: 梯度消失与爆炸：深度怎样把局部导数放大成指数效应 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从标量连乘到矩阵雅可比，从 sigmoid 饱和到 RNN 时间展开；用数值例子理解初始化、门控、残差、归一化和梯度裁剪分别改变哪段路径。

pages.title: Vanishing and Exploding Gradients: How Depth Turns Local Derivatives into Exponential Effects · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From scalar products to matrix Jacobians, from sigmoid saturation to RNN unrolling over time; use numerical examples to understand how initialization, gating, residuals, normalization, and gradient clipping each change which segment of the path.

pages.title: 对比学习：用正对与负对塑造表示空间 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 InfoNCE、温度与梯度方向，到增强不变性、大批量、假负样本、表示坍缩和迁移验收。

pages.title: Contrastive Learning: Using Positive and Negative Pairs to Shape Representation Space · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From InfoNCE, temperature, and gradient direction, to augmentation invariance, large batches, false negative samples, representation collapse, and transfer validation.

pages.title: CLIP：用图文对比把两种模态对齐到同一空间 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从双编码器、归一化相似度矩阵和对称交叉熵，到零样本分类、检索、组合关系与偏差边界。

pages.title: CLIP: Using image–text contrast to align two modalities into the same space · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From dual encoders, a normalized similarity matrix, and symmetric cross-entropy, to zero-shot classification, retrieval, compositional relations, and bias boundaries.

pages.title: 系统提示：在概率模型里声明行为契约，而不是建立安全边界 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从消息序列、指令优先级、冲突解析和上下文拼装，到注入、泄露、版本化与契约测试，理解系统提示能控制什么。

pages.title: System Prompts: Declare Behavioral Contracts in Probabilistic Models, Not Security Boundaries · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From message sequences, instruction priority, conflict resolution, and context assembly to injection, leakage, versioning, and contract testing—understand what system prompts can control.

pages.title: 上下文工程：设计模型在这一刻真正能看见的信息 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 把提示词、检索证据、工具结果、记忆与历史消息当成有限预算下的信息系统，而不是把所有文本一股脑塞进窗口。

pages.title: Context Engineering: Designing the Information the Model Can Actually See at This Moment · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Treat prompts, retrieved evidence, tool results, memory, and historical messages as an information system under a limited budget, rather than cramming all the text into the window.

pages.title: 响应预填充：让模型从一个给定的答案前缀继续 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 理解 assistant prefix 如何改变条件分布，并与输入 prefill、提示缓存和约束解码严格区分。

pages.title: Assistant Response Prefilling: Letting the Model Continue from a Given Answer Prefix · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Understand how the assistant prefix changes the conditional distribution, and strictly distinguish it from input prefill, prompt caching, and constrained decoding.

pages.title: 结构化输出：把概率文本接入确定性软件契约 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从最小 schema、约束生成和分层校验，到版本迁移、有限修复与安全执行。

pages.title: Structured Outputs: Connecting Probabilistic Text to Deterministic Software Contracts · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From minimal schema, constraint generation, and layered validation to version migration, limited repair, and secure execution.

pages.title: 模型选型与成本：寻找满足约束的最小可行方案 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从任务分布、强模型上界和多维门禁，到每成功任务成本、帕累托前沿与退出策略。

pages.title: Model Selection and Cost: Finding the Minimal Viable Solution That Satisfies Constraints · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From task distribution, strong-model upper bound, and multidimensional gates, to cost per successful task, Pareto frontier, and exit strategy.

pages.title: 检索与语义搜索 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从知识库里找出最相关的少量内容，喂给模型作答

pages.title: Retrieval and Semantic Search · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Surface the most relevant snippets from a knowledge base and feed them to the model for answering.

pages.title: 可观测性与追踪：重建一次 AI 请求为何得到这个结果 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 用 trace、span、版本、质量信号和最小化数据，把“偶发答错”变成可定位、可回放、可回归的问题。

pages.title: LLM Observability and Tracing: Reconstructing Why an AI Request Got This Result · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Use traces, spans, versions, quality signals, and minimized data to turn “occasional wrong answers” into locatable, replayable, regression-testable problems.

pages.title: 数据漂移与持续监控：分布变化何时真的伤害系统 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 P(x)、P(y) 与 P(y|x)，到 PSI、延迟标签、代理指标、切片告警和安全响应。

pages.title: Data Drift and Continuous Monitoring: When Distribution Change Actually Harms the System · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From P(x), P(y), and P(y|x) to PSI, delayed labels, proxy metrics, slice alerts, and safe response.

pages.title: 幻觉 Hallucination · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 流畅、自信、却是编的——为什么这是结构性的，而不是「再大一点就好」

pages.title: Hallucination · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Fluent, confident, but fabricated — why this is structural, not 'just make it bigger'.

pages.title: AI 隐私：沿数据流控制可识别性、记忆与越权使用 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从采集、提示、检索、日志、供应商到模型权重，逐站理解个人数据怎样扩散，以及怎样用最小化、隔离和可验证删除缩小风险。

pages.title: AI Privacy: Controlling Identifiability, Memorization, and Unauthorized Use Along Data Flows · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From collection, prompts, retrieval, logs, vendors, to model weights, understand station by station how personal data spreads, and how to reduce risk through minimization, isolation, and verifiable deletion.

pages.title: 反思与自我修正：让失败证据改变下一次行动 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 区分空泛自评、外部反馈和可验证修正，用最小改动、停止条件与版本化经验避免“再想一遍”制造更自信的错误。

pages.title: Reflection and Self-Correction: Making Failure Evidence Change the Next Action · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Distinguish vague self-assessments, external feedback, and verifiable corrections; use minimal changes, stopping conditions, and versioned experience to avoid “thinking it over again” producing more confident errors.

pages.title: 自洽性：用多条独立推理路径投票 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 理解采样多样性、答案聚合、相关错误、成本与置信估计，并区分多数一致和事实正确。

pages.title: Self-consistency: Voting with Multiple Independent Reasoning Paths · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Understand sampling diversity, answer aggregation, correlated errors, cost, and confidence estimation; and distinguish majority agreement from factual correctness.

pages.title: 智能体规划：把目标变成可执行、可修订的状态图 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从目标、前置条件、产物和完成谓词理解计划—执行分离、滚动规划、检查点与局部重规划。

pages.title: Agent Planning: Turning Goals into Executable, Revisable State Diagrams · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Understand planning–execution separation, rolling planning, checkpoints, and local replanning through goals, preconditions, artifacts, and completion predicates.

pages.title: 智能体框架：抽象运行循环，但不外包正确性与控制权 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从模型适配、工具注册、状态图、持久化和追踪，到抽象泄漏、版本迁移与逃生口，判断何时框架值得引入。

pages.title: Agent Frameworks: Abstract the Run Loop, but Don't Outsource Correctness and Control · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From model adaptation, tool registration, state graphs, persistence, and tracing, to abstraction leaks, version migration, and escape hatches, determine when a framework is worth adopting.

pages.title: Agent 记忆：可写、可找、可纠正的外部状态 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 把会话上下文、工作状态、情景记录和长期事实分开，理解写入、整合、检索、遗忘、冲突与隐私治理。

pages.title: Agent Memory: Writable, Findable, and Correctable External State · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Separate conversational context, working state, episodic records, and long-term facts; understand writing, integration, retrieval, forgetting, conflict, and privacy governance.

pages.title: 代码生成 / AI 编程 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 让模型写代码，从补全一行到实现整个功能

pages.title: Code Generation / AI Coding · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: Let models write code, from completing a line to implementing an entire feature.

pages.title: 多智能体系统：用边界、并行与独立验证组织复杂任务 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从任务依赖图、通信拓扑和共享状态，到关键路径、移交损失与同源错误，判断何时多智能体真的优于单智能体。

pages.title: Multi-agent Systems: Organizing Complex Tasks with Boundaries, Parallelism, and Independent Verification · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From task dependency graphs, communication topologies, and shared state to critical paths, handoff losses, and common-source errors, determine when multi-agent truly outperforms single-agent.

pages.title: 人在回路：把稀缺的人类判断放到能改变风险的节点 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从风险分层、升级阈值、审核界面和队列容量，到自动化偏见与反馈采样，设计真正降低伤害的人机闭环。

pages.title: Human-in-the-loop: put scarce human judgment at the points where it can change risk · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From risk stratification, escalation thresholds, review interfaces, and queue capacity to automation bias and feedback sampling, design a human-machine loop that truly reduces harm.

pages.title: 工作流编排：用持久状态和确定性控制承载概率模型 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从 DAG、状态机和持久执行，到幂等、重试、补偿、版本迁移与人工任务，建立可恢复、可审计的 AI 流程。

pages.title: Workflow Orchestration: Carrying Probabilistic Models with Persistent State and Deterministic Control · AI Knowledge Map
pages.description: From DAGs, state machines, and durable execution, to idempotency, retries, compensation, version migration, and human tasks, build recoverable, auditable AI processes.

pages.title: 流匹配：直接学习把噪声连续运输到数据的速度场 · AI 知识地图
pages.description: 从概率路径、条件速度和边缘速度，到直线路径、ODE采样、数值误差、配对设计及与扩散/连续流的关系。
